---
title: q.signal Roadmap

## Implemented foundation

- [x] Canonical ordered pandas Series and time-by-asset DataFrame contract
- [x] Directional threshold and stateful hysteresis rules
- [x] Cross-sectional normalization, selection, and exposure neutralization
- [x] Strictly aligned weighted signal combination
- [x] Causal row delay and exponential decay
- [x] Minimum holding periods and post-exit cooldowns
- [x] Per-asset turnover limiting and bounded target-exposure conversion

## Planned

- [ ] Calendar-aware availability and stale-signal policies
- [ ] Long-form panel adapters keyed by time and asset
- [ ] Signal provenance for model, rule, and parameter lineage
